extensionDescription.message: Native browser dark mode with saved website and section rules.

rulesNote.message: Saved locally. Disabled rules remain as exclusions. Specific sections take priority. Queries and fragments are ignored.

importNote.message: Rules absent from the file are kept. Enabled rules may activate dark mode in matching open tabs.

debugNote.message: Brave may show a debugging banner. Closing it or opening DevTools may disconnect dark mode.

scopeFamily.message: Saved scope: {scope} and its subdomains. A leading www is ignored.

active.message: Native dark mode is active in this tab.

inactive.message: Native dark mode is inactive in this tab.

exportPrepared.message: Export prepared: {count} rules. Check your browser downloads.

fileValidated.message: File validated. No settings have changed yet.

importCanceled.message: Import canceled. No settings were changed.

importSaved.message: Import saved: {added} added, {updated} updated, {skipped} unchanged. Matching tabs are being updated.

errorJson.message: The file is not valid JSON.

errorSize.message: Choose a JSON backup no larger than 1 MiB.

errorLimit.message: The configuration may contain at most 1,000 rules.

errorRule.message: Rule {count} is invalid. Check its hostname, path and settings.

errorTimeout.message: The browser is taking too long. The rule may already be saved. Reopen the popup to check.

errorPage.message: Open an HTTP or HTTPS page to manage website rules.

errorDetached.message: Connection ended ({reason}). Automatic activation is paused for this tab. Enable it manually to resume.

errorScopeConflict.message: A rule already exists for this scope. Edit it from the saved list.

regionalAvailability.message: Enter a base domain such as example.com.

errorInheritedRuleChanged.message: The tab no longer inherits a rule. Reopen the popup.
